notes: Capability benchmark for the post-M9.4 catalog. Real user-like prompts; the model must infer presentation. expected_channel in {markdown,native,rich}; expected_family is the primary native family. expect_mixed=true means the ideal answer is Markdown intro + native UI + short Markdown interpretation.
